text: {player} was spotted at a late-night curling tournament in Kapuskasing. He returned with a bronze medal and a suspicious attitude.
{player} pulled a hamstring at team bowling night. He insists it was {opponent_player}'s fault for throwing a strike at the wrong moment.
The zamboni at {arena} broke down mid-game last night. The ice was resurfaced using two brooms and a garden hose. Your next home game may be affected.
The league has banned visor decorations following an unexplained incident in Moncton. Teams have until Thursday to comply. Nobody is sure what happened in Moncton.
{player} gave an interview this week claiming he 'invented a new skating technique.' Video review suggests he tripped and recovered unusually gracefully.
{player} reported late to practice this morning citing a 'beef with a moose on Highway 11.' The moose was unavailable for comment.
The Regional Circuit arena in Smooth Rock Falls temporarily lost power last night. The game was completed by smartphone flashlight. League officials called it 'fine, technically.'
Your backup goalie {goalie} has developed a pre-game ritual that involves humming the full national anthem backwards. The team is supportive. Mostly.
{player} got into a fight with the building's automated parking system before last night's game. He is fine. The machine did not apologize.
The Commissioner has announced a 'Spirit of the Game' initiative. Nobody is sure what it means. A pamphlet is expected by spring.
{player} was named player of the week by a regional newspaper that publishes once a month. He framed the article.
The roof at {arena} is leaking again. Tonight's home game will have a tarp over one corner of the ice. Players have been warned to avoid the tarp.
A seagull entered {arena} during warmups. It sat on the net for eleven minutes. Officials declared it a 'guest' and waited it out.
{player} was suspended one game for arguing with a referee about a call that happened in a different game, on a different night, involving a different team.
Three teams in the RC played their road games this week on a rink that was slightly too small. Results will stand. The league apologizes.
{player} has started signing autographs as '{player} (The Legend).' His teammates have not commented. His agent is unaware.
{player} reported what he described as a 'spiritual injury' ahead of this week's games. The team doctor assessed him and found nothing physically wrong. He sat out anyway.
The Cochrane Chickens have requested a team name change. The league denied it, citing 'contractual fun obligations.' The Chickens remain.
Your team bus broke down 40km outside of Wawa. Players arrived by a combination of taxi, hitchhiking, and one snowmobile. You won.
Local television covered a Smooth Rock Falls Smoothies game last night and accidentally aired 45 minutes of the Zamboni garage instead. Ratings were apparently fine.
{player} is going through 'something.' His performance may be affected. The team is rallying around him in the way hockey players do, which is to say silently and with occasional light shoving.
The Moose Jaw Antlers' GM Darcy Spratt reportedly offered a player a contract written on a Tim Hortons napkin. The player declined but kept the napkin.
{player} had a hat trick last week and has not stopped mentioning it. Morale in the locker room is complicated.
The league's official puck supplier has changed. Players report the new pucks feel 'slightly different.' Officials say they are identical. The debate continues.
{player} was named team captain by accident when the announcement email had a typo. He has taken the role very seriously. The actual intended captain has not said anything.
Your arena's scoreboard is stuck displaying a score from a 2014 pre-season game. It will be fixed by the next home game. Probably.
{player} challenged the opposing team's enforcer to a fight, lost, and then challenged him again immediately. He lost again. The crowd in Hearst gave him a standing ovation.
The Elliot Lake Atoms have installed a uranium-themed night at their arena. Tickets come with a small glow-in-the-dark pin. The league has questions.
{player} missed the team photo because he thought it was optional. It was not optional. He has been quietly fined.
The Commissioner announced a new rule: all overtime goals must be celebrated 'with restraint.' Players and coaches have expressed confusion. Restraint begins next week.
